svg.title: HYDRA-UMC-SERVER architecture
svg.desc: HYDRA-UMC-SERVER authenticates every call, turns commands into state changes under reservations and limits, saves the state as one unit, broadcasts it over the WebSocket, and relays to the ecosystem services under the access switches an administrator sets.

svg.text: The one place that decides who may move which robot: every client is just a caller of this server.
